correctness.rationale: The signed simplicial Lefschetz calculation is exact in all dimensions because only one homology degree survives; each nonempty g-invariant face has sign (-1)^(t-u) under the vertex permutation and contributes (-1)^(u-1) after its chain degree is included. The empty face contributes -1. Every rotational orbit graph is a cycle C_d (with explicit d=1,2 conventions), and every reflected orbit graph is a path of one of three lengths. The path recurrence yields period-six evaluations. The arithmetic sum over all rotations and the reflection cancellation or split produce cyclic and dihedral invariant multiplicities; barycentric subdivision removes inversions for quotient-chain averaging. Direct code independently checked 266 characters and 10 full mod-two homology instances.

value.rationale: The formula gives the complete degree-graded rational \(D_n\) homology character of a natural infinite family, including exact fixed rotation/reflection traces and quotient invariant dimensions. The mod-12 distinction between cyclic and full dihedral quotients is a structural transformation-group invariant not provided by ordinary homology ranks. The formulas apply to every n≥3, are conceptually motivated by symmetry and orbit posets, and are not an arbitrary finite slice or a minor Betti-number increment.
